item.title: Rocket.Chat OAuth2 NoSQL Injection Privilege Escalation — CVE-2026-29198

Summary

Rocket.Chat’s OAuth2 authentication flow builds a MongoDB query from attacker-influenced OAuth2 profile/identity fields without sufficient sanitization, allowing NoSQL injection operators to be smuggled into the user lookup query. By crafting a malicious OAuth2 response, an attacker can manipulate the query Rocket.Chat uses to match/create the authenticated user record, enabling account takeover or privilege escalation (including an --escalate mode in the PoC) without valid credentials.
